issues.detail: The Greek 'εαν δε μη' (ean de me) functions as a conditional/concessive structure meaning 'unless'. The Vietnamese 'Nếu không có' (If there is no) combined with 'thì' (then) creates a standard 'if-then' conditional. More importantly, the Greek 'σιγατω' (sigatō) is a subjunctive of 'be silent'. The Vietnamese 'phải im lặng' (must be silent) adds a modal of necessity ('phải') that is not present in the Greek grammar.
